name: hsm-workspace
description: Device Modeling Framework: Langium based modeling environment for product structures and hierarchical state machines

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/language && npm run build -w packages/web && npm run build -w packages/vscode
scripts.dev: npm run langium:generate && npm run dev -w packages/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/language && npm run test -w packages/vscode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/language && npm run typecheck -w packages/web && npm run typecheck -w packages/vscode
scripts.docs:examples: npm run build -w packages/language && node packages/language/bin/cli.js doc examples -o docs/examples --title "Example state machines" && node packages/language/bin/cli.js render examples/device/system.dmf -o docs/examples/GarageDoor.svg && node packages/language/bin/cli.js render examples/device/drive.dmf -o docs/examples/DriveUnit.svg
